title: Descent and scalar normalization of the actual finite quotient diagram
statement: Let X,d,phi,M,V,T satisfy the assumptions of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-stalk-models]: phi is invertible and scalar/quotient compatible, every supplied algebraic level is perfect, and the actual quotients have separate local markings by those levels. Then the actual-quotient data [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-actual-normalization] against the explicit constant diagram exists. Its conclusion omits all Isom-presheaf reductions and all constant-diagram cohomology and universality assertions.

source.place: Tag 09C6, finite quotient levels and the normalized algebraic diagram; Tags 06YY and 09BV.

proof.text: Separate markings by each perfect constant level give bounded finite locally constant cohomology for the actual quotient on the chart. Apply finite-ring bounded constructible derived origin to descend it to K_n; full faithfulness descends its specified consecutive arrows.

Tensor balancing of consecutive strict quotients proves sourcewise universality. Exact scalar-extension pullback mates identify these arrows on each etale source and give their restriction coherence. At a geometric point choose a member of its levelwise marking cover. Full faithfulness gives the etale local derived isomorphism; the sheafification unit gives the inhabited Isom stalk.

Realize finite fixed coefficients as modules over the actual finite ring sheaf using its locally bijective constant-scalar unit. Forget finite quotient scalars along the completed projection and restrict to W→U; these exact functors give realization. Two successive scalar restrictions give scalar. Descent identifies the actual level, and constant realization with the universe lift identifies the explicit model level.

The scalar and quotient compatibility of phi identify the two ring homomorphism composites. Localize their termwise scalar restriction comparisons and use tensor-pullback compatibility for the model. The resulting two identities are exactly actual_normalized and model_normalized, with the specified strict and algebraic transitions.

theorem finitePerfectAdic_actual_normalization
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale)
    (T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d)
    (hperfect : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.IsPerfect (T.level n))
    (hmark : FinitePerfectAdicLevelMarkings X d φ M V T) :
    Nonempty (FinitePerfectAdicActualNormalization X d M V T)
